description:
# Check: upstream overlay-options.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-options.test.ts

## Subject
TUI overlay positioning, sizing, and rendering options.

## Upstream test count (approx)
32

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- truncates overlay lines exceeding declared width
- handles complex ANSI sequences without crashing
- overlay composited on styled base content
- handles wide characters at overlay boundary
- positioned at terminal edge
- overlay on base content with OSC sequences
- renders overlay at percentage of terminal width
- respects minWidth when widthPercent results in smaller width
- positions: top-left, bottom-right, top-center
- clamps negative margins to zero
- margin as number; margin object with individual sides
- offsetX and offsetY from anchor position
- rowPercent and colPercent positioning; rowPercent 0 → top; rowPercent 100 → bottom
- truncates to maxHeight and maxHeightPercent
- row and col override anchor
- multiple overlays with later ones on top
- overlays at different positions without interference
- proper hiding in stack order

## Upstream dependencies
Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal

## Upstream notes
Options: width (number or "%" string), anchor (top-left, bottom-right, top-center, center), margin (number or object {top,left,right,bottom}), offsetX/offsetY, row/col, minWidth, maxHeight, maxHeightPercent. Percentages computed. Negative margins clamped to 0. Overlays render in creation order by default; focused overlays render on top.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/overlay_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
